title: Auth pre-validation at BearerAuth/BasicAuth construction is correct — must not be deferred to first request
description: BearerAuth::new and BasicAuth::new validate the header value at construction time (HeaderValue::from_str). A contributor might suggest deferring validation to the first request to 'simplify' the constructor. This would be wrong: runtime errors from per-request credential injection are harder to surface, debug, and test than construction-time errors. The current design fails fast at the point where the programmer has the wrong value, not at 03:00 when the first request is sent. The pre-computed header_string also eliminates per-request allocation. Both the fast-fail and the allocation savings justify the current approach.
